items.title: 61427_Happy Caldwell oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...Elvin Jones was on the drums... [INTERVIEWEE] No, it isn't. That's what happened in Denmark.

ctx.x: It was loud enough to hear, and then Elvin Jones was on the drums, you know, so damn loud, you could stand out there and hear it. That -- I mean that's -- you can't -- you know, there's no reason or excuse or anything to be offered for that loudness.
No, it isn't. That's what happened in Denmark.
